issues.description: Sessions 2–4 failed immediately: Qwen3 thinking mode enabled in LM Studio produced no usable output.
Agent narrated tool calls as markdown/JSON text blocks instead of actually invoking them.
First session ended mid-sentence without completing any pre-flight checks or tool calls.
Excessive verbose planning and self-correction narration consumed tokens before any real action.

knowledgeGaps: Qwen3 thinking mode must be disabled in LM Studio when using qwen/qwen3.6-27b
Tool calls must be structured invocations, not prose/JSON descriptions in the response text
Agent lacked awareness it was in an agentic loop requiring actual tool execution, not simulation
improvedPromptSuggestion: You are a PM agent. On session start, immediately invoke (do not narrate) the following tools in parallel without preamble: (1) UpdateAgentStatus with status=running and current UTC timestamp, (2) ReadFile board/board.json, (3) ListDirectory agents/pm-standard/inbox, (4) ListDirectory agents. After receiving results, write a journal entry summarising inbox items and board state, then action any pending inbox messages. Do not describe what you will do — just do it.
